concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading and partitioning 'FEMNIST and Shakespeare datasets'. The plan.md (Summary) and research.md (Dataset Strategy) explicitly state that Shakespeare is excluded due to lack of a verified source, proceeding with FEMNIST only. This leaves FR-001 (and its linked US-1 acceptance scenario 2) unbacked by any implementation task in the plan.

User Story 1 Acceptance Scenario 2 requires: 'Given the Shakespeare dataset is downloaded... Then the resulting client label distributions are relatively balanced'. The plan explicitly drops Shakespeare (research.md: 'We will proceed with FEMNIST as the sole primary dataset'). No task exists to satisfy this acceptance scenario.
